title: GOP Senator Issues Warning to Trump After Fresh Legal Blow - Newsweek
summary: Senator Thom Tillis warns Trump after a judge quashes a subpoena against Federal Reserve chair Jerome Powell, potentially complicating Kevin Warsh's confirmation as his successor. Tillis criticizes the administration's legal actions as pressuring the Fed and undermining its independence.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is negative due to concerns over the independence of the Federal Reserve and the potential delay in confirming a new Fed chair amidst legal and political pressure.
